memoryBuilder.verseText: Anyone who belongs to Jesus is made brand new.

sequence.prompt: What happened to Saul? Put it in order.

items.label: Saul locked up the friends of Jesus
A bright light knocked him to the ground
Saul told everybody Jesus is God's Son

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: He was hurting the friends of Jesus
'I am Jesus — the One you are hurting'

application.question: God did not make Saul better — He made him new. What can only God make new?

options.label: How I treat my brother or sister
Someone I think could never change

application.followUp: Saul was hurting God's people, and God chose him anyway — gave him a new heart, a new job and even a new name. Nobody has to become good enough first, because nobody ever could. Jesus makes me new.
